paper.title_en: Full analytic expressions of overlap reduction functions for anisotropies of the stochastic gravitational-wave background with pulsar timing arrays
paper.abstract_en: Pulsar timing arrays (PTAs) have detected a stochastic gravitational-wave background (SGWB) in the nanohertz band, enabling tests of gravity and cosmology, as well as studies of supermassive black holes and early Universe physics. PTA data analysis relies on cross-correlating timing residuals, where overlap reduction functions (ORFs) critically determine sensitivity. Conventional ORF calculations using the short-wavelength approximation break down for the scalar longitudinal mode and cannot handle frequency dependence or anisotropies. This work rigorously derives the full response functions within an analytical cross-correlation framework. We reveal, for the first time, intrinsic symmetries and relations among anisotropic ORF integrals for all polarizations. By variable substitutions and coordinate rotations, we transform complex integrals into tractable forms, resolving divergences in vector and scalar longitudinal modes. Building on this, we establish a universal framework yielding fully analytical expressions for anisotropic ORFs to arbitrary order for all six modes. As a direct application, we give complete expressions up to l <= 5. This framework is free of approximations; its (0,0) component recovers the isotropic Hellings--Downs curve. Compared with numerical integration, our results offer broader applicability, faster computation, and higher precision, providing a valuable foundation for anisotropic sky mapping, polarization-mode separation, and new-physics searches with PTA data.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文在脉冲星计时阵列的各向异性随机引力波背景的重叠约化函数方面提供了完整的解析表达式，包含严格的推导和新的对称性，具有较高的理论深度和创新性。
decision.title_zh: 脉冲星计时阵列随机引力波背景各向异性的重叠约化函数的完整解析表达式
decision.abstract_zh: 脉冲星计时阵列（PTAs）已在纳赫兹频段探测到随机引力波背景（SGWB），从而能够检验引力和宇宙学，以及研究超大质量黑洞和早期宇宙物理学。PTA数据分析依赖于对计时残差进行互相关，其中重叠约化函数（ORFs）决定灵敏度。使用短波长近似的传统ORF计算对于标量纵模会失效，且无法处理频率依赖性或各向异性。本工作在解析互相关框架内严格推导了完整的响应函数。我们首次揭示了所有偏振的各向异性ORF积分的内在对称性和关系。通过变量替换和坐标旋转，我们将复杂的积分转化为可处理的形式，解决了矢量模和标量纵模中的发散问题。在此基础上，我们建立了一个通用框架，为所有六种模式提供了任意阶的各向异性ORF的完全解析表达式。作为直接应用，我们给出了l≤5的完整表达式。该框架无近似；其(0,0)分量恢复了各向同性的Hellings--Downs曲线。与数值积分相比，我们的结果具有更广泛的适用性、更快的计算速度和更高的精度，为PTA数据的各向异性天空测绘、偏振模式分离和新物理搜索提供了宝贵的基础。
